description: This file defines a router for outbound session bindings, including types, functions for resolving bindings based on requester info, and the main createBoundDeliveryRouter function.

methods.name: isActiveBinding
methods.description: Checks if a session binding record has an 'active' status.

methods.name: resolveBindingForRequester
methods.description: Finds a matching session binding record for a given requester from a list of bindings.

methods.name: createBoundDeliveryRouter
methods.description: Creates a router object with a method to resolve delivery destinations based on session bindings and requester info.
